name: Quietville [HORROR]
desc:
Quietville… A place where echoes linger. Secrets whisper. And the darkness… waits.

⚠️ FPS HORROR GAME!

WARNING: The game contains loud jumpscares and flashing lights!

The game also has references to many other horror games.

# CONTROLS

PC: E Interact, C to Crouch, X to Stand up, F for Flashlight
